label: Code map rebuild
purpose: Redraws the navigable code map of one project from its current source, so the map never describes code that has moved.

label: Client site archive
purpose: Copies a client site's newest nightly snapshot into a private archive each week.

label: Status page nightly
purpose: Rebuilds the status page’s snapshot, sends it to the page’s server, and commits the day’s token-usage history before its source ages out.

label: Page taps applied
purpose: Applies the taps I make on the Command Center page to my own notes, so a close or snooze on the phone lands in the one record of them.

label: Phone check
purpose: Checks that the PC can still reach my phone, re-arms the link after the phone restarts, and reports what it found to the Command Center page.

label: Status page refresh
purpose: Every half hour, gathers what is waiting on me, what it cost, what is broken and what moved, and sends it to my phone page.

label: Encrypted backup
purpose: Takes an encrypted backup of a private store, so losing this PC does not lose it.

label: Dev server reaper
purpose: Stops local development servers left running on registered ports.

label: Drive scrub
purpose: Reads every file stored on the PC’s drive once a month, so a damaged spot is found while the rest of the file can still be saved.

label: Estate preserve
purpose: Commits and pushes every project and this machine’s settings on a clock rather than on a session, so a week without a session is not a week without a backup.

label: Nightly test tier
purpose: Runs the slow test tier of every project and reports any failure at the start of the next session.

label: Site check
purpose: Compares this site’s systems pages with this PC each morning and opens a window to publish any change with one click.

label: Machine watch
purpose: Reads this PC’s health (disk, memory, hangs) and reports anything wrong at the start of the next session, because a machine that is merely unusable logs almost nothing.

label: Traffic log trim
purpose: Keeps the logged request and response bodies, kept deliberately for studying each new tool version, from filling the disk.

label: Reference sites rebuild
purpose: Rebuilds the two reference sites that map this whole setup, in the one order that is correct, because one reads what the other builds.

label: Restore rehearsal
purpose: Walks the restore runbook against the backups without rebuilding anything, because a backup nobody has restored from is a guess.

label: Stray process sweep
purpose: Finds and stops background shell processes nobody is waiting on.

label: Desktop layout audit
purpose: Backs up and audits the taskbar layout, and speaks up only when something is wrong.

label: Task agent wake
purpose: Wakes the task agent when work is waiting for it.

label: Assistant schedule check
purpose: Wakes the assistant agent when one of its scheduled entries is due.

label: Daily ops digest
purpose: Sends me a summary of what the agents did and what is waiting on me.

label: Alerting heartbeat
purpose: Pings me every week whether or not anything broke, so a dead alert channel shows up as a missing ping instead of a missed outage.

label: Workload export
purpose: Exports each agent’s workload numbers into its own repo, where the board reads them.

label: Domain request broker
purpose: Checks the agents’ requests to reach new web domains and escalates each one to me for a decision.

label: Agent tooling update
purpose: Stages each new release of the agents’ own tooling, tests it, and switches them over only when it passes.

label: Goal judge
purpose: Decides whether a standing goal’s latest run finished or should continue.

label: Petition broker
purpose: Validates the agents’ requests for host changes and escalates them; nothing is granted automatically.

label: Poller watchdog
purpose: Restarts the agents’ chat pollers if they stall.

label: Outbound send gate
purpose: Validates anything an agent wants to send outside and holds it for my approval.

label: Proxy log rotation
purpose: Rotates the logs of the proxy that all of the agents’ outbound traffic goes through.

label: Phone alert watch
purpose: Every five minutes, looks for a new red fault, a new question from an agent or something coming back today, and sends one notification for each; quiet overnight except for red faults.

label: Morning summary
purpose: Sends one notification each morning: what is waiting, what it cost, what is broken and what moved, across everything including both agents.

label: Agents status fetch
purpose: Fetches both agents’ own status files so the phone page shows their questions, spend and faults beside everything else.

label: Repos and job board refresh
purpose: Refreshes this site’s public repos list every day, and pulls and scores the job board every morning; gates both for anything private, and commits only what changed.

label: Podcast sync
purpose: Publishes any new podcast episode to this site after checking its audio and provenance.

label: Librarian
purpose: Librarian — nightly curation pass

label: Vault sync
purpose: Vault sync (commit brain writes, converge with GitHub)

label: MCP reaper
purpose: Reap leaked MCP filesystem children by restarting the remote connectors

label: Firewall audit
purpose: Firewall audit — nightly tripwire over the synced (Open + Private) tiers

label: Watchdog
purpose: Watchdog — 10-min staleness sentinel (silent-failure detector)

label: Pipeline canary
purpose: Pipeline canary — daily end-to-end filing proof (drop -> model -> note -> ledger)

label: Alert heartbeat
purpose: Weekly alerting heartbeat — a dead alert channel becomes noticeable by ABSENCE

label: Skills refresh
purpose: Skills refresh (mirror canonical claude-code-skills into the vault tree)

label: Graph audit
purpose: Graph-health audit — nightly read-only tripwire over the Open knowledge graph (#9)

label: Auto-refresh
purpose: Regenerate the architecture view from the latest repo (self-refresh)
